faq.q: Where is Rahul Chanda Photography located?
faq.a: The studio is based in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. Rahul travels with full mobile lighting setups across India for on-location productions.

faq.q: What does Rahul Chanda Photography specialize in?
faq.a: Commercial photography: e-commerce product photography, food & beverage photography (restaurants, cafes, delivery apps), footwear and sneaker catalogs, fashion lookbooks, and brand advertising campaigns, with in-house retouching.

faq.q: How much does product photography cost in India?
faq.a: Product photography starts at ₹10,000 for a compact product shoot. Full e-commerce catalogue work (20+ SKUs) starts at ₹25,000; larger catalog runs (200+ SKUs) and marketplace-specific Amazon/Flipkart/Myntra packs are quoted per project based on volume, styling, and deliverables.

faq.q: What is the typical delivery timeframe?
faq.a: Standard turnaround is 5–10 business days after the shoot. Rush turnaround (24–48 hours) is available on request. Bulk catalog work is delivered in batches so listings can start early.

faq.q: What file formats are delivered for e-commerce?
faq.a: Platform-ready JPG, PNG and WebP/AVIF sized for Amazon (2000×2000+), Flipkart (1000×1000+), Myntra (3:4 portrait), Shopify and direct web use, colour-managed sRGB with embedded ICC profiles, plus 16-bit TIFF/PSD masters.

faq.q: Do you shoot on location or in a studio?
faq.a: Both. On location at the client's warehouse, office or venue with full studio lighting brought on site; for large catalog jobs a temporary studio is set up at the client's facility.

faq.q: What footwear photography angles are covered for e-commerce?
faq.a: Standard coverage includes the three-quarter hero, medial profile, lateral profile, top-down, sole detail, and pair shot; brand campaigns add lifestyle in-use contexts and macro detail shots of stitching, texture and materials.

faq.q: Can you match the exact colour of a product?
faq.a: Yes. A Calibrite ColorChecker reference target is shot on every scene, white balance is locked against neutral patches, and the workflow is colour-managed end to end so leather, suede, mesh and synthetic finishes match the actual product.
Yes. All commercial deliverables include colour calibration, surface dust cleanup, frequency separation and contrast sculpting done in-house.

faq.q: How do I book a shoot?
